[[Swiftspell's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Mugra Swiftspell]], a [[boss]] in [[Ferndale]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Fast Casting]] +1 (20% chance while using skills)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jeweled Staff]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated. A [[Staff Wrapping]] of [[Of Attribute|Fast Casting]] does not exist and a [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Mastery]] would produce [[Illusion Magic]] +1 (20%).
